evidence: Running DataCollatorWithFlattening on features whose labels are torch.Tensor objects raises TypeError('can only concatenate list (not "Tensor") to list').
The same collator succeeds when labels are provided as Python lists, producing flattened input_ids, labels, and position_ids.
steps: Created an isolated Python venv and installed the minimal runtime dependencies listed in requirements.txt.
Executed repro.py with PYTHONPATH pointed at codebase/src.
Observed the tensor-label failure and the successful list-label case in the same run.
